note_on_recording: held-out look-0 datasets were recorded (not read) before this file; no held-out image, label or result was opened. Dev (train/validation seeds, 100 tray objects, batch of 24 seeds) informed the numbers.
decision_unit: one tray object, looks accumulated up to 3 re-looks; barcode-off arm is the headline (barcode channel disabled; the aimed close-up views of look 0 are still in the data)

required_sample.note: 140 held-out seeds hold about 500 known and 45 unregistered-twin tray objects; if coverage stays near the dev 68 percent, named objects (about 340) fall short of the 380 a 1 percent bound needs even with zero errors, so the false-identity bound is then reported inconclusive, not passed.

pass_rule: upper Wilson limit under the bound and sample met = pass; point estimate over the bound = fail; else inconclusive. Coverage passes only if the lower Wilson limit reaches its floor. Latency, re-look and wrong-after-escalation bounds are plain comparisons. One run, no re-run after a fail.
